scope:
Audit hardware flags and charge-dependent shapes without refitting the detector.

The frozen primary cohort remains intact. Bit-0x8000-clear and stricter subsets
are sensitivity comparisons, not experimentally certified single-particle truth.
selection: Original primary quality and first60% of run3/run12; run18 already-explored check. MC frozen candidate quality + 200 ADC, no refit.

flag_definition_evidence.verification_scope: Primary-manual indexed text only. Direct mirror PDF returns HTTP404; official legacy download redirects to HTML. Not a full-PDF verification.
flag_definition_evidence.interpretation: Recorded hardware tag; no proof of two physical pulses or a perfect single-event selector. Other bits are retained, not rejected collectively.

shape_sampling: Deterministic evenly spaced original indices, at most 600 per group; normalized in [-40,3000)ns. Full training absolute means use all supported selected events.

Co60.rule: Positive finite Q; half-open intervals, boundary goes to higher bin

Am241.rule: Positive finite Q; half-open intervals, boundary goes to higher bin

timestamp_scope: Intervals among saved waveforms only, not all hardware triggers or the source rate.
origin_definition: MC origin has >=90% of in-window avalanche charge; 0 includes mixed/unknown. 1 alpha family, 2 gamma family, 3 decay electrons, 4 recoil, 5 other.
